name: enabled
label: Enable livestream
description: When off, public pages and MediaMTX webhooks are rejected.

name: mediamtx_api
label: MediaMTX control API
description: Optional MediaMTX HTTP API base (not required for basic OBS → HLS).

name: srt_publish_host
label: SRT publish host (public)
description: DynDNS / public hostname for remote OBS.

name: srt_local_host
label: SRT local host
description: Host for OBS on the same PC or LAN (usually 127.0.0.1).

name: rtmp_port
label: RTMP port
description: MediaMTX RTMP listener for phone apps / OBS (forward TCP on the router).

name: hls_public_base
label: HLS public base
description: Browser-facing HLS base URL with no trailing slash (e.g. http://afaaro.myvnc.com:8888).

name: hls_proxy_upstream
label: HLS proxy upstream
description: MediaMTX base the HTTPS site proxy fetches from (public DynDNS on soomaali.net; 127.0.0.1 on home WAMP).

name: hls_cdn_secret
label: HLS CDN secret
description: Must match MediaMTX hlsCDNSecret so the HTTPS proxy can fetch without session cookies.

name: auth_upstream
label: Auth upstream
description: Home MediaMTX only: forward publish auth to soomaali.net. Leave empty on soomaali.net.

name: stats_upstream
label: Stats upstream
description: soomaali.net studio Live feed: home telemetry URL when MediaMTX API is not local. Leave empty on home WAMP if API is reachable.

name: hls_transcode_h264
label: Transcode to H.264 for website
description: ffmpeg publishes {slug}_h264 (H.264+AAC) for soomaali.net; original path stays for VLC/HEVC.

name: transcode_key
label: Transcode publish key
description: Password for ffmpeg user=transcode publishing to {slug}_h264 (must match on-online.bat).

name: webhook_secret
label: Webhook secret
description: Shared secret for MediaMTX runOnReady / runOnNotReady hooks.
